items.source: Called after a session's tool index has been cleared — either because this strategy returned it from ToolIndexEvictionStrategy.onAccess(String), or because of an explicit eviction request.
items.translation: 在会话的工具索引被清除后调用——无论是因为该策略通过ToolIndexEvictionStrategy.onAccess(String)返回了它，还是因为显式的驱逐请求。

items.source: Called each time a session is accessed at the start of request processing.
items.translation: 每次在请求处理开始时访问会话时都会调用。

items.source: Expiry is evaluated lazily on each onAccess(String) call: all tracked sessions (other than the one currently being accessed) are checked against the TTL, and any that have exceeded it are returned for eviction. No background thread is used.
items.translation: 过期检查在每次调用 onAccess(String) 时惰性执行：所有被跟踪的会话（除当前正在访问的那个之外）都会与 TTL 进行比较，任何超过该期限的会话将被标记为待驱逐。此过程不使用后台线程。

items.source: Implementations should update their internal tracking state for sessionId and return the set of session IDs whose tool indexes must now be cleared. The returned set must never include the currently-accessed sessionId.
items.translation: 实现应更新其内部跟踪状态以处理sessionId，并返回必须清除工具索引的会话 ID 集合。该返回集合绝不能包含当前正在访问的sessionId。

items.source:
The TTL resets on every access, so a session that continues to receive requests will
not be evicted as long as the gap between consecutive requests stays below the TTL.
items.translation: TTL 会在每次访问时重置，因此只要连续请求之间的间隔小于 TTL，持续接收请求的会话就不会被驱逐。

items.source: Implementations should remove any internal tracking state for the evicted session.
items.translation: 实现应移除被驱逐会话的任何内部跟踪状态。

items.source: ttl - maximum idle time before a session's index is evicted; must be positive
items.translation: ttl - 会话索引在空闲状态下的最大存活时间，必须为正数。

items.source: session IDs to evict; never null, may be empty
items.translation: 待驱逐的会话 ID；永远不会为null，可能为空。

items.source: A ToolIndexEvictionStrategy that evicts sessions whose last-access time is older than a configured time-to-live (TTL).
items.translation: 一个 ToolIndexEvictionStrategy，用于驱逐最后访问时间早于配置的生存时间（TTL）的会话。
